stopping_rules: Stop when explicitly capped new cash has been spent, even if planned episodes remain
Stop when explicitly capped creator labor has been spent, including abandoned attempts
Require every attempted episode's costs and hours, including zero-result episodes, before calculation
Metric outcomes must be owner-observed comparable units within the preregistered scope; views do not imply purchases or creator cash
An exhausted time window without complete episodes is a discontinued or incomplete pilot, not proof the niche is commercially unviable
Minimum exposure protects against declaring an unsupported positive result; if missing, no audience conclusion is made
boundary_conditions: Already-owned equipment usage allocation is an economic cost, not new cash expenditure. Do not also charge its original purchase price as paid in the same period unless actually paid.
No numeric sample outcomes, expected conversion probabilities or creator hourly earnings can be inferred from source documentation alone.
Native YouTube Analytics data is owner-authorized; public video views and simulated fixtures are not observations of income.
The scoring engine is not an estimate of all-creator success rates, causal performance or audience representativeness.
